purpose: Concise strategic profiles for the user's prominent Position 1 hero pool. These are coaching priors, not rigid builds.

Sven.identity: Tempo physical carry: accelerate with cleave, then convert God’s Strength + mobility/BKB timings into decisive fights.
skills: Great Cleave: farming accelerator; prioritize dense wave + stacked-camp routes.
Warcry: use proactively for move speed/armor when entering or disengaging, not only after damage starts.
God's Strength: major commitment window; avoid low-value fights when it is unavailable.
items: Early farm/tempo: Power Treads + efficient sustain/farm components.
Core decision: Blink for access; BKB when control prevents sustained hitting.
Damage after access/survivability: choose crit, attack speed, dispel or anti-evasion according to targets.
neutral: Prioritize attack speed/damage when you can connect reliably.
Prefer survivability/status resistance when enemy control is the real limiter.
Mobility is high value when it changes Blink follow-up or target access.
Sven.draft: Prefer when your team can provide vision/setup and the enemy backline is punishable by burst initiation. Be cautious into heavy kiting, saves and repeated BKB-piercing control.

Ursa.identity: Short-range tempo carry/Roshan threat: win through Fury Swipes stacking, repeated jump windows and forcing close fights.
skills: Fury Swipes: long trades and Roshan scale rapidly; preserve contact on the same target.
Overpower: synchronize with jump/disable windows rather than spending charges into kite.
Enrage: defensive timing tool that lets you commit through burst/control windows.
items: Early tempo: boots + lane/farm efficiency, then solve target access.
Blink is often the key conversion item; BKB when spells stop contact.
Basher/Abyssal, dispel or anti-kite options depend on whether lockdown or survivability limits kills.
neutral: Attack speed has exceptional value when it improves Fury Swipes stacking.
Movement/access effects are valuable against kite-heavy drafts.
Durability/status resistance rises in value when you must survive the first control chain.
Ursa.draft: Prefer into melee/frontline heroes you can stay on and lineups that struggle to reset your engagement. Be cautious into layered slows, disengage, saves and elusive ranged cores.

Phantom Assassin.identity: Assassination/scaling carry: use Blur/map ambiguity and Phantom Strike access to delete a priority target once defensive answers are solved.
skills: Stifling Dagger: secure lane resources and safely apply attack modifiers.
Phantom Strike: access + burst window; do not spend it where the exit/kill is unclear.
Blur: farming/map-pressure tool as well as defense; exploit information denial.
items: Choose farming acceleration versus earlier Desolator tempo from lane/draft state.
BKB is often the permission-to-hit item, not an optional luxury.
Basher/Abyssal, Satanic/dispel, Nullifier, MKB or break are conditional solutions after core damage/access.
neutral: Raw damage/attack speed amplifies burst when survivability is already solved.
Defensive/status-resistance choices are better when one disable decides the fight.
Mobility/access value is lower if Phantom Strike already reaches the correct target reliably.
Phantom Assassin.draft: Prefer when enemy supports/cores can be isolated and lack reliable saves or anti-burst. Be cautious into heavy armor, break, evasion/miss, instant disables and multiple saves.

Juggernaut.identity: Flexible lane/tempo carry: combine Blade Fury safety, Healing Ward sustain and Omnislash/Swiftslash isolation to pressure objectives and punish separated targets.
skills: Blade Fury: kill/survival tool; avoid wasting it if magic immunity is needed for the next threat.
Healing Ward: objective and reset resource; ward positioning often determines whether pressure continues.
Omnislash: strongest on isolated high-value targets; track nearby units and defensive saves before committing.
items: Build farming/attack-speed efficiency when the map allows scaling; accelerate fighting when your team can convert Omni windows.
Manta/dispel, BKB, Butterfly/Skadi, Basher or Nullifier are matchup solutions rather than fixed sequence.
Attack speed improves both farm and ultimate damage delivery; balance it against access and survivability.
neutral: Attack speed/damage is strong when ultimate and right-click uptime are reliable.
Defensive/status-resistance options help when you can be controlled outside Blade Fury.
Mobility is valuable when it creates isolation for Omnislash or improves split-map pressure.
Juggernaut.draft: Prefer when Blade Fury answers key magic threats and enemy heroes are vulnerable to isolation. Be cautious into summons/illusion clutter, strong saves, physical mitigation and BKB-piercing lockdown.
